answer_1.quote: Open-ended answer generation for each retrieved document z k is performed with a generative model, such as T5

answer_2.quote: The following metrics are applied to assess the quality of individual answers generated and documents retrieved. ... VQA Score: ... Exact Match (EM) ... Pseudo Relevance Recall (PRRecall)@K ... Hit Success Ratio (HSR) ... Free Success Rate (FSR)
